newsitem.title: USA: First of Michigan names Soule as chairman.
newsitem.headline: First of Michigan names Soule as chairman.

text.p: First of Michigan Capital Corp said Friday it has elected Edward Soule to its board of directors and as chairman of the board, effective immediately.
Soule is a former partner of Edward D. Jones Inc, a financial securities firm.
Soule succeeds William Cuddy, who continues as a member of the board and chairman of the audit committee.

Soule, 44, was chief financial officer of Edward D. Jones in St. Louis, and was a member of its management committee, from 1986 to 1995. He was chief financial officer for Transworld Airlines through December 1996.
First of Michigan's principal subsidiary is First of Michigan Corp, Michigan's largest full-service securities firm.
